svg.title: Compressor nameplate with GS1 DataMatrix
svg.text: Compressor nameplate (serial label) with GS1 DataMatrix – layout, data and Application Identifiers
Plate 100 × 60 mm, drawn at 6 px per mm. Anodised aluminium or polyester label, laser or thermal-transfer resin print. Values are examples.
Data in the symbol (GS1 element string)
Encoded data (FNC1 = start, GS = ASCII 29 separator):
• (01), (11) have predefined length – no separator after them.
• (21) is variable and not last – GS separator before (240).
• Parentheses appear only in the human-readable line.
data codewords = 40 → smallest square ECC 200 symbol
module X = 6 dots = 0.508 mm (GS1 range – check spec)
symbol = 26 × 0.508 = 13.2 mm; + quiet zone 1X each side
→ 14.2 mm square area on the plate
1 Text ≥ 2.5 mm high for the serial (here 13 px = 2.2 mm at 6 px/mm – use ≥ 3 mm on the real plate).
2 Same serial in plain text and in the symbol; plain text is the legal record if the code is damaged.
3 Quiet zone ≥ 1 module around the DataMatrix; no rivet, edge or text inside it.
4 Legal content (maker, model, serial, year, pressure, power, voltage, conformity marking where required)
follows the law of the market (machinery and pressure-equipment rules) – check before print.
5 Verify the printed symbol with an ISO/IEC 15415 verifier: target grade B (3.0), accept ≥ C (2.0).
Guide 15 – numbering and identification · digital twin
